title: Weather Dial — Tiny City Climate Toy

checks.name: JavaScript syntax and local dependency check
checks.command: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const h=fs.readFileSync('index.html','utf8'); const s=h.match(/<script>([\\s\\S]*?)<\\/script>/)[1]; new Function(s); console.log('JavaScript parse: passed'); console.log('Buildings:',(s.match(/name:\\"/g)||[]).length); console.log('Remote refs:',(h.match(/https?:\\/\\//g)||[]).length);"
checks.details: The embedded JavaScript parsed successfully, the deterministic city defines 14 named buildings, and the HTML contains zero remote URL references.

checks.name: Acceptance interaction wiring
checks.command: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),h=fs.readFileSync('index.html','utf8'),r=fs.readFileSync('README.md','utf8'); const script=h.match(/<script>([\\s\\S]*?)<\\/script>/); if(!script)throw Error('script missing'); new Function(script[1]); const checks={buildings:(script[1].match(/name:\\"/g)||[]).length>=12,weathers:(h.match(/data-weather=/g)||[]).length===6,presets:(h.match(/data-preset=/g)||[]).length===4,canvas:h.includes('canvas id=\\"city\\"'),gust:h.includes('state.gusts.push'),cloudBurst:h.includes('c.burst=2.5'),buildingCard:h.includes('showBuilding(b,x,y)'),keys:h.includes('e.code===\\"Space\\"')&&h.includes('e.key.toLowerCase()===\\"r\\"'),noRemote:!(/https?:\\/\\//.test(h)),docs:r.includes('Direct-open')||r.includes('direct-open')}; for(const [k,v] of Object.entries(checks)){if(!v)throw Error(k+' failed')} console.log('Acceptance wiring: passed',checks);"
checks.details: Verified all six weather choices, four presets, canvas scene, gust painting, cloud bursts, building cards, keyboard shortcuts, documentation, and local-only runtime wiring.

checks.name: Direct-file 1600 by 900 visual render
checks.details: Chrome opened index.html directly from disk and captured a complete first frame with the animated rainy city, roads, traffic, people, trees, clouds, and full console visible.

checks.name: Narrow responsive direct-file render
checks.details: The direct-open scene rendered at 600 by 900 with the diorama readable and the console reorganized into a compact responsive layout.

summary: A self-contained animated Canvas 2D tabletop city with deterministic weather storytelling, six coherent climate modes, reactive citizens, traffic, trees, lighting, accumulation, tactile controls, presets, gust painting, cloud bursts, and accessible status.
